mapper.sql: select c.checkin_id, c.user_id, c.sign_date, c.points, c.continuous_days, c.create_time from learning_checkin c
mapper.select: where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.sign_date desc
select count(*) from learning_checkin where user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from learning_checkin where user_id = #{userId} and sign_date = #{signDate}
mapper.insert: insert into learning_checkin (user_id, sign_date, points, continuous_days, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{signDate}, #{points}, #{continuousDays}, sysdate())
